change: Check the packaged text model's SHA-256 and schema during image build, before a candidate image can be deployed
expected_effect: A missing or mismatched packaged CPU model fails the candidate build instead of failing its first text job
risk: An intentional model revision requires updating the reviewed digest; this gate does not prove runtime dependencies, GPU model availability or service health
next_experiment: Build a candidate image from an isolated context with the model file removed, then confirm the build fails; build the unchanged context and run the CPU deployment smoke
rollback: Discard the candidate image or revert this Dockerfile patch and redeploy the previously recorded image ID; no database or object-store migration is involved
scope: Offline proposal and command-level replay only; patch is not applied to the deployed Dockerfile
